findings.highlight: I don't feel happiness or suffering.
findings.evidenceJa: 幸い、苦しいなんて事はなかった。
findings.governingReading: Fortunately he does not suffer, because sensation has nearly turned to iron.

findings.highlight: My five senses have already turned to iron.
findings.evidenceJa: 五感は、そのほとんどが鉄になっている。
findings.governingReading: Most of his senses have turned to iron.
findings.explanation: Nearly all sensation becomes all five senses.
